description: Only 20 canonical amino acids are allowed at each GB1 site.
Prefer one-site changes relative to an already measured parent.
Use conservative versus radical substitutions as contrasting hypotheses.
A beneficial substitution is supported only in its measured sequence background.
Combining beneficial substitutions requires new measurements because of epistasis.
Count mutations relative to WT separately from changes relative to a parent.
Protein-level 4-AA variants cannot contain a stop codon; DNA design needs codon checks.
